extension.description: Use the ADR Guard CLI safely from a trusted VS Code workspace.
view.adrExplorer.welcome:
Open a local workspace folder to browse ADRs.
[Refresh](command:adrGuard.refreshExplorer)
configuration.title: ADR Guard
configuration.cli.path: Absolute path to the trusted ADR Guard executable. When empty, the workspace extension host PATH is searched.
configuration.cli.timeoutMilliseconds: Maximum time in milliseconds for an ADR Guard CLI invocation.
configuration.cli.maxOutputBytes: Maximum bytes captured separately from stdout and stderr for an ADR Guard CLI invocation.
configuration.mcp.enabled: Enable the optional ADR Guard MCP server definition for this workspace folder. Disabled by default.
configuration.mcp.path: Absolute machine-local path to adr-guard-mcp.dll or the native adr-guard-mcp executable on the workspace extension host.
mcp.provider.label: ADR Guard MCP servers
configuration.ui.language: Language used by the ADR Guard Webview: automatic (VS Code), Portuguese (Brazil), or English. Native VS Code UI keeps the editor language.
configuration.creation.documentLanguage: Default language for new ADR documents in this workspace folder.
configuration.creation.defaultTemplate: Default ADR creation template: CLI-configured, minimal, or extended.
configuration.validation.directory: Workspace-relative ADR directory used by validation and ADR creation.
configuration.validation.adrFormat: ADR document format used by validation, index generation, and Explorer metadata: canonical or MADR 4.0.
configuration.validation.baseline: Workspace-relative path to the existing diagnostic baseline JSON file used by baseline validation.
configuration.validation.onSave: Validate ADRs after saving a Markdown file in the configured ADR directory. Disabled by default.
configuration.validation.debounceMillise: Delay in milliseconds used to coalesce validation after saves.
configuration.validation.baseReference: Default local Git reference suggested for incremental validation. The command remains editable and never fetches automatically.
configuration.analysis.driftBaseline: Optional workspace-relative architectural drift baseline path.
configuration.analysis.driftPolicy: Default architectural drift policy. Advisory is the safe default.
configuration.ai.provider: Preferred AI provider for explicitly initiated draft and review operations. No provider is selected by default.
configuration.ai.model: Preferred provider model identifier. ADR Guard does not choose a default model.
configuration.ai.endpoint: HTTPS endpoint used only by the openai-compatible provider. Credentials are never stored here.
